about_short_description.short_description: Bringing the UK's best restaurants home. Exclusive menus, delivered across the country.

product.name: Chef-Prepared Restaurant Menus
product.description: Pre-prepared, portioned restaurant meals created by partner chefs and delivered chilled nationwide for customers to finish, heat, plate, and serve at home.

product.name: Supper Club Membership
product.description: An annual Dishpatch membership offering account credit, free delivery, access to member-exclusive menus, priority access to limited releases, and member offers.

product.name: Dishpatch Food Gifting
product.description: Food gifts including restaurant meal menus, chef-created hampers, letterbox desserts, and gift cards for recipients to enjoy or redeem at home.

product.name: Corporate Gifting
product.description: A corporate food-gifting service supporting bulk deliveries of restaurant meals and food gifts with personalised messages for staff, clients, and other recipients.

product.name: Wine and Drinks
product.description: A selection of wines and other drinks available alongside Dishpatch menus, including restaurant-branded wines and products recommended for pairing with specific meals.
